decisions.reason: Query 'stegepande' is a direct category search. Anchor IDs include Eva Trio Stainless Steel Stegepande (100439699), Scanpan Impact (100414740), Jamie Oliver Cook Smart (100454201), Scanpan Fusion 5 (100414744), and Eva Trio Multi 5-ply (100468229), all of which are stegepander in inventory. Six shapes are represented across the pans category. All anchors are relevant, in stock, and grounded in catalog data. No invented products or requirements.

Query 'pande til stegning' is a natural Danish synonym for stegepande. Anchors 100439699, 100454201, 100414740, 100468229, 100452302 are all stegepander directly suited for stegning. The synonym mapping is straightforward and all products are confirmed in inventory. No hidden requirements or invented evidence.

Query 'rustfri stegepande' targets stainless steel frying pans. Anchors 100439699 (Stainless Steel, genanvendt rustfrit stål), 100468230 (Stainless Steel Honeycomb, genanvendt rustfrit stål), 100453812 (Multi Mosaic, genanvendt aluminium/rustfrit stål), 100468229 (Multi 5-ply, genanvendt rustfrit stål), 100466778 (Multi Mosaic, genanvendt rustfrit stål/aluminium) all explicitly list rustfrit stål as material in catalog text. Subtype is well-grounded.

Query 'Scanpan stegepande' requires brand Scanpan. Anchors 100455457 (CS+ Rec.), 100414744 (Fusion 5), 100414740 (Impact) are all Scanpan stegepander confirmed in inventory. Three products is appropriate for a brand search where only three Scanpan pans appear in the catalog. No invented products.

Query 'Eva Trio Multi Mosaic stegepande' requires brand Eva Trio and family Multi Mosaic. Anchors 100466778 (Multi Mosaic Stegepande) and 100453812 (Multi Mosaic Stegepandesæt) are both explicitly named Multi Mosaic in catalog. Both are in stock. Two results is correct given only two Multi Mosaic pans appear in inventory.

Query 'Scanpan Fusion 5 stegepande' is a named product search. Anchor 100414744 (Scanpan Fusion 5 Stegepande) is exactly matched by brand Scanpan and family Fusion 5 in catalog. Single result is appropriate for a named product. In stock online and in store.

Query 'krus' is a broad category search. Anchors include Royal Copenhagen Blå Mega Riflet Krus (100081624), Hvid Riflet Krus (100081719), Kähler Hammershøi Sommer Krus (100422284), Bjørn Wiinblad Guirlande Krus (100353910), and Moomin Arabia Vinternats Glød Krus (100470572), all explicitly named krus in catalog. Seasonal mugs are valid mugs per instructions. All grounded in inventory.

Query 'kaffekop' maps to cups/mugs suitable for coffee. Anchors include Royal Copenhagen Blå Mega Riflet Krus (100081624), Hvid Riflet Krus (100081719), Alfabet Kollektion Højhankskop/Mor (100461453), Eva Trio Legio Nova Kop (100353731), and Sort Riflet Blonde Termokop (100422904). Per instructions, generic kopper can include ambiguous cup uses and the query does not explicitly restrict to a single drink type. Højhankskop and kop are natural synonyms for kaffekop. All products are in catalog.

Query 'termokrus' targets cups with thermal/insulating function. Anchor 100422904 (Royal Copenhagen Sort Riflet Blonde Termokop) is explicitly named Termokop in catalog. Anchor 100449899 (Stanley The Quencher H2.0 Flowstate Tumbler) is a double-wall insulated tumbler in rustfrit stål, a recognized thermal drinkware product. Both are grounded in inventory. Two results is appropriate given only these two thermal-function items appear in the cups catalog.

Query 'Kähler krus' requires brand Kähler. Anchors 100470237 (Hammershøi Jul Krus 2026), 100470232 (Hammershøi Jul Krus 2018 & 2025), and 100422284 (Hammershøi Sommer Krus) are all Kähler krus in catalog. Seasonal mugs are valid. Three results matches the Kähler krus inventory available.
